detail.longDescription: On a high-speed paper machine, vibration control is critical. This 6600mm project uses the following balance grades: Rolls: G1.6 Dryer cylinders: G2.5 Reel roll: G1.6 Reel roll balancing speed: 2900 m/min These specifications help maintain stable operation and extend bearing and roll life. Paper grades: high-strength corrugated paper and T paper. Basis weight: 90–150 gsm. leizhanworld@gmail.com
